title: Periodic graph operators with reducible dispersion polynomials for all potentials
summary: We give a complete characterization of periodic graph operators whose dispersion polynomials are reducible for every potential. Consequently, the reducibility dichotomy for parameter-dependent Laurent polynomials implies that, for every other periodic graph operator, the dispersion polynomial, and hence the Bloch variety, is irreducible for generic potentials. Our proof proceeds through two reductions. We first use the monodromy of the roots of the dispersion polynomial with respect to the potential parameters to reduce the problem to the splitting case.
